column1: # The challenge id grammar's shared case table (app#494, ADR-0041).
# A challenge id is a directory name under challenges/, `NN-slug`. The grammar has
# ONE Go definition, challengeid.Pattern; the copies this table holds equal:
#            challenge mode), run row by row by scripts/check-deploy-user-ids.sh
# The other shell / Helm copies (gen-values.sh, scripts/*.sh, the chart's
# regexMatch guards) are NOT registered yet: app#472.
# A row is never dropped to make an implementation pass: the implementation that
# disagrees is the bug. A change to the grammar changes the rows in the same commit.
# Format: the same as internal/identity/testdata/seat-cases.tsv (see its header):
# `input<TAB>accept|reject`, split on the FIRST tab, `#` and blank lines ignored,
# the closed placeholder set {LF} {U+202E} {U+00FC} {U+00EF}; line 1 is the
# canonical `# pattern: ` literal. The table stays ASCII.
# `all` and `scenario:<name>` are deploy-user.sh's other two modes, not challenge
# ids: they are not rows here (challengeid.Valid("all") is false), and
# An empty input is the usage error of deploy-user.sh (exit 1), not a grammar verdict
# --- baseline: the real challenges and the verify probe
# --- shape: two digits, a hyphen, a slug of at least one character
# a trailing hyphen is inside the grammar (ADR-0041): the case table says what the grammar is
# --- length: the slug is 1 to 60 characters
# --- the slug: lower-case letters, digits, hyphen only
# --- not an id at all: path traversal, absolute paths, the other mode's word
# --- control and bidi characters, a trailing newline
